title: The normalized approximation function for multiple zeta-star values
summary: Motivated by the classical Lagrange spectrum and the reciprocal formulation of the Lagrange spectrum in continued-fraction theory, we introduce a normalized approximation function $\mathcal{N}(α)$ for approximation by multiple zeta-star values. At each depth, the approximation error is minimized over all admissible indices and normalized by the binary scale determined by their weights. The function $\mathcal{N}(α)$ is then obtained by taking the limit inferior as the depth tends to infinity.
